authority: Missouri Secretary of State and local election authorities
caveat: This is a source inventory for administration context. It records official source locations, current collection status, and request needs; it is not a normalized row-level audit, CVR, incident, recount, correction, or litigation dataset.

precinctResults.sourceTitle: Missouri Secretary of State election results and statistics
precinctResults.scopeNote: Official 116-election-authority President, U.S. Senate, turnout, and historical rows remain retained. Active canonical artifacts expose 115 Census counties/county-equivalents after the reviewed Jackson County/Kansas City aggregation. The SOS results page still identifies precinct-level files as purchasable, so precinct review remains blocked until obtained.
precinctResults.requestNeed: Purchase or request 2024 general election precinct-level result files for President and U.S. Senate, plus any reporting-unit definitions needed to distinguish Kansas City and county jurisdictions. See data/mo-2024-source-request-tracker.json for the request packet fields.

checkedPageEvidence.officialStatement: The Missouri SOS results page states that precinct-level election results are available for general November elections from 1996 to 2024 and directs purchasers/questions to the Elections Division.
checkedPageEvidence.contactPath: Missouri SOS Elections Division email listed on the results page

equipment.sourceTitle: Verified Voting Verifier Missouri 2024 equipment context; Missouri SOS qualified voting systems and election-security pages
equipment.scopeNote: Verifier rows are jurisdiction-level equipment context only. The SOS election-security page documents statewide requirements and links the qualified voting systems page, which lists systems approved for Missouri statutory requirements.
equipment.nextAction: If official county equipment assignments are needed beyond Verifier context, request 2024 county equipment inventories or certification records from the Secretary of State or each local election authority.

audit.sourceTitle: Missouri election law book and SOS election-security page
audit.scopeNote: Missouri rules describe post-election verification/manual recount procedures, including a public random selection of at least five percent of precincts, certificates filed with the Secretary of State and public records, and discrepancy investigation before certification when thresholds are exceeded. The SOS election-security page also states that Missouri has 116 election jurisdictions, each with its own voting system, and that election results are audited by local election officials before certification. No 2024 statewide audit selection/outcome table is loaded.
audit.recordsRequestNeed: Collect or request 2024 post-election verification certificates, selected precincts, selected contests, machine totals, hand totals, discrepancies, explanations, and final outcomes from the Secretary of State or local election authorities.

cvr.sourceTitle: Missouri election law book CVR definition and SOS/local records request path
cvr.scopeNote: Missouri rules define cast vote records in the electronic-voting-system context, but no statewide public 2024 CVR export or county CVR availability table is loaded. Keep CVR availability separate from the purchasable precinct-level results file.
cvr.recordsRequestNeed: Confirm county-by-county whether 2024 general-election CVRs exist, are releasable, and how they can be requested, including custodian, format, redaction limits, and ballot-mode fields.

incidentsCorrectionsRecountsLitigation.sourceTitle: Missouri SOS election results, Elections Integrity Unit, HAVA determinations, and election law book
incidentsCorrectionsRecountsLitigation.scopeNote: The SOS results page lists historical recount result links for some past elections but not a 2024 general-election recount link in the checked page. The Elections Integrity page identifies complaint paths and published HAVA determinations; the 2026 Kramer determination references 2022 and 2024 voter-registration/list and reconciliation allegations and related federal-court hearing-process orders. No normalized 2024 incident, correction, recount, or litigation rows are loaded.
incidentsCorrectionsRecountsLitigation.recordsRequestNeed: Inventory official 2024 amended canvasses, correction notices, recount petitions/outcomes, HAVA determinations, court dockets/orders, and local incident reports before adding row-level administration context.

precinctGeometryCrosswalks.sourceTitle: Missouri SOS local election authority directory and county/request path

loadedGeometry.scopeNote: Loaded Census geometry supports 115 county/county-equivalent FIPS joins. The canonical result artifacts sum Kansas City within Jackson County with Jackson County outside Kansas City into county:29095; no standalone Kansas City polygon is created.

precinctGeometryCrosswalks.scopeNote: County FIPS reconciliation is resolved for the active canonical artifacts. No official statewide precinct-boundary geometry or precinct-to-election-authority crosswalk was identified, so subcounty mapping remains blocked.
precinctGeometryCrosswalks.requestNeed: Request 2024 precinct boundary GIS, precinct identifiers, split precinct definitions, and crosswalk fields that join the purchasable precinct result file to county/Kansas City/St. Louis City reporting jurisdictions. See data/mo-2024-source-request-tracker.json for the request packet fields.

displayApiCaveats.advisoryUse: Current Missouri advisory rows compare official President and U.S. Senate totals at canonical Census county grain. Jackson County includes both SOS election-authority source rows. These are screening inputs, not findings, and not precinct-level scatter plots.
displayApiCaveats.productionPromotion: No production promotion is authorized from this worker pass. Regenerate staging and run native:report-indicators before any later promotion.
